FAKE-SYNTHETIC demo visit note: synthetic data, roles only.
Visit notes, Pioneer Family Clinic 024 (Texas; corporate owner). Pediatric medicine is the main facility type on this book. Met the clinic manager and the pharmacy director at the flagship pediatric site. This was a shorter call than planned because a clinic huddle ran over.

I started with a scale snapshot only: about $430K in net dollars, a couple of percent of the in-state total among the synthetic peers and a small slice of national dollars. The pharmacy director filed that away and said they already think of this as a smaller book.

We then confirmed switching: no material switching between the two windows. The clinic manager was glad to hear that and did not want to spend more time on manufacturer-window charts today.

The rest of the visit was operational. They walked me through front-desk flow in the pediatric wing, a staffing gap on two weekday afternoons, and how they want leave-behinds to go to the clinic manager first, not to the front desk. The MSA term has ended and auto-renews; they know the term ended and asked that any later contract conversation go through the pharmacy director, not through this visit. I did not open mix, class shares, or ratio pages, and I did not ask the purchasing-drivers question. Those items are still on my list for a follow-up once they have a full slot.

No second meeting was booked. I will send a short thank-you and wait for them to offer a longer time.
